name: Machi Gurumi no Wana ~Hakudaku ni Mamireta Shitai~
original_name: 町ぐるみの罠～白濁にまみれた肢体～
source:
Lewd eyes from all directions.... Atsuko has just moved to a town to work as a teacher. She looks forward to her new life there, but what awaits her is.... Yes, she gradually gets involved in a storm of sexual assaults planned by the whole people in the town....

淫邪的目光从四面八方投来…敦子刚搬到一座小镇担任教师。她满怀期待地迎接新生活，等待她的却是…没错，她逐渐被卷入一场由全镇居民共同策划的性侵风暴…
